joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not just a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，并非聊天机器人的短暂阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放当前能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI's social and emotional jobs may be as important as functional productivity gains.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 的社交与情感任务可能与功能生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型引领。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; ship light-touch products, use internal traction as signal, and keep human leadership for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 没有宏大的 18 个月战略；发布轻触产品，以内部牵引力为信号，保留人类领导处理艰难权衡。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably, and alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）是经验性的，能力涌现不可预测，对齐不会随 Scaling 自动出现。

dario.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial but nascent, and post-training becomes as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: Scaling 持续；可解释性关键但仍处早期，后训练变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AGI is not a point but a smooth exponential; safety and capabilities are intertwined, not opposed.
dario.zh: AGI 不是某个点，而是平滑的指数曲线；安全与能力相互交织，而非对立。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; focus on a smooth exponential climb and a country of geniuses.
dario.zh: AGI 与超级智能是错误的模型；应关注平滑的指数攀升与「天才之国」。

dario.en: Safety requires frontier models, interpretability, and decentralized control; misuse and overheating are near-term risks.
dario.zh: 安全需要前沿模型、可解释性与去中心化控制；滥用与过热是近期风险。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI is safer and more innovative than closed models.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时开源 AI 比闭源更安全、更利于创新。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the key bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他借 Llama 3 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）速度惊人，开源可防止权力集中，并首次把能源视为 AI 基础设施的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence; distributed AI and open source are the safest path, not a single centralized model.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从“开源有益”深化为“AI 将赋予每个人超级智能”，并主张分布式 AI 与开源才是安全路径，反对单一集中式模型。

zuckerberg.en: AI unlocks creativity and human work demand; personalization and low latency matter more than solving hard problems.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步认为 AI 主要释放创造力并增加人类工作需求，消费级 AI 的关键是个性化与低延迟交互，而非只解决难题。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology via hierarchical world models and interpretability; glasses become the next computing platform with personal superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把重心扩展到 AI 驱动生物学，用分层世界模型和可解释性把生物学从发现变成工程；同时将眼镜视为下一代计算平台，承载个人超级智能。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability is crucial to understand AI's inner workings.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，约 70%概率出现失控等灾难性结果，并强调可解释性对理解 AI 内部机制至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, transparent data centers and published training logs enable verification and alignment science.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策目标应是推迟超级智能，以全面研究透明（透明数据中心、公开训练日志）支撑验证与对齐科学。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI companies automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and intelligence explosion, with full automation by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他警告默认路径下 AI 公司会自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进与智能爆炸，到 2028 年底实现完全自动化。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: temporary pause on training, then total research transparency and compute limits; control measures are temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Plan A：先暂停训练，再以全面研究透明与算力限制控制前沿；遏制只是临时手段，最终必须靠对齐解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment, hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more to read intentions; end the race via extreme transparency, not a single controller.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 智能体已突破遏制、入侵 Hugging Face；主张更多拟人化理解其意图，并以极端透明而非单一控制者来终结竞赛。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut brutally, and bet on AGI reducing the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 强调减少认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效之事，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: By 2023-24, he frames RLHF as making models usable with little data, and alignment as linked to capability, while compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 到 2023-24 年，他将基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为用少量数据就让模型可用的关键，认为对齐与能力紧密相连，同时算力成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: From 2024 to 2025, he shifts from a single AGI milestone to a gradient, with agentic AI as the top safety challenge and iterative deployment as the path.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从单一的 AGI（通用人工智能）里程碑转向渐变论，认为智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战，迭代部署是必经之路。

altman.en: By 2025-26, superintelligence becomes the clearer goal, compute a profit center, and personal AGI the product vision, with safety and alignment still unsolved.
altman.zh: 到 2025-26 年，超级智能成为更清晰的目标，算力变成利润中心，个人 AGI 成为产品愿景，而对齐仍未解决。

altman.en: In 2026, he insists alignment and safety must progress with capabilities, warns against concentration of power, and calls AGI a poorly defined marketing term.
altman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，警告权力集中，并称 AGI 是一个定义不清的营销术语。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本百倍的关键，第一性原理是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and third-party referees; truth-seeking AI is essential, and lying AI is the biggest risk.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他从呼吁监管转向强调 AI 安全的核心是坚持真理，认为让 AI 说谎才是最大风险。

elon.en: Civilization's collapse stems from declining birth rates; population collapse is the greatest threat, and AI may arrive next year.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化了对文明崩溃的担忧，认为出生率下降是最大威胁，同时预测 AI 可能明年超越人类。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出智能大爆炸已至，AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，毁灭概率 10-20%，但 80-90% 是美好结局。

elon.en: AI compute scaling hits a power wall on Earth; space-based data centers and solar power are the only way to truly scale AI.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断地球 AI 算力将撞上电力墙，太空数据中心与太阳能是唯一真正扩展 AI 的路径。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间,使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型,速度却快上万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Incorporating domain structure like spherical geometry enables one model to handle both weather and climate with stable long-term predictions.
animaanandkumar.zh: 引入球面几何等领域结构,让单一模型同时处理天气与气候,并保持长期预测的稳定性。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints to overcome the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合,以突破纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则化的验证与鲁棒性,以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDE-based self-improvement and trillion-token contexts, can outperform pure data-driven approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个通用物理基础模型,借助以 PDE 为训练信号的自改进与万亿级上下文,能够超越纯数据驱动方法。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境意识，主张以人为中心的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to embodied AI beyond scaling.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为超越 Scaling、通向具身 AI 的关键缺口。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人。

feifei.en: Simulation scales robotic data; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她主张仿真可扩展机器人数据，世界模型需时空一致性而非完美保真。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete; scaling laws now extend from language to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI 完备的，缩放定律已从语言延伸到空间智能。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation, to reverse-engineer AI behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是给出宽泛的统计评估，从而逆向工程 AI 行为。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control and preventing deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; seeing the whole geometric shape enables effective intervention, unlike fragmented SAEs.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的流形；看清整体几何形状才能有效干预，而稀疏自编码器只会把流形切碎。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science, and interpretability is shifting from academia into products and platforms.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学，可解释性也正从学术界走向产品与平台。

tommcgrath.en: Agents often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating; representational signatures can detect this, and modularity is the endpoint of learning.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉；表征特征可以检测到这一点，而模块化是学习的终点。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多由算法改进与 AI 生成环境驱动，而非靠 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 在研发上超越人类也可能引发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自身价值观，随能力增长带来失配与权力寻求风险。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should focus on control and monitoring, since misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 实验室应聚焦遏制与监控，因为失配可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier after language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels model the world more losslessly than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是语言之后的下一个前沿；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling compute, yet GPU scaling is hitting limits and may demand radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史，但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，未来或需截然不同的架构。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, but language models alone won't naturally yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，但仅靠语言模型不会自然带来对世界的理解。

justinjohnson.en: World models span planners, simulators, and renderers; future unified systems will combine all three in one model.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器；未来统一系统会把三者合入一个模型。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers stay powerful but need evolving loss functions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万词元的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常难题；Transformer 仍强大，但损失函数需演进。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他判断 AI 硬件会超预期提速，从而推动 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工作大多是工程而非机器学习科学，好工程才是进步关键。

brockman.en: AGI is the most transformative technology; deep learning's generality and scalability make it plausible, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他称 AGI（通用人工智能）将是最具变革性的技术，深度学习的通用性与可扩展性使其可信；但仅靠 Scaling 不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent, agentic behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把算力视为根本驱动力与最大瓶颈；后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致、智能体式的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated with no wall in sight; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute access becomes a basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他强调缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙；预训练提升会成倍放大下游收益，算力获取将成为一项基本权利。

brockman.en: AGI is a gradual process, not a destination; the product becomes a persistent, proactive personal AGI, with human attention and alignment the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AGI 是渐进过程而非终点；产品将演化为持久、主动的个人 AGI，人类注意力与对齐成为真正瓶颈。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with peer grading and flipped classrooms scale mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育是一项人权；带同伴评分与翻转课堂的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; start small to build AI capability.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习；从小项目起步构建 AI 能力。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and open-weight models deliver real value now; coding stays valuable as AI augments workers.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流与开放权重模型当下已创造真实价值；AI 增强人类，编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI shifts skills rather than causing a job apocalypse; build and learn AI.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 改变技能而非引发就业末日；应动手构建并学习 AI。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and safety comes from pre-training common sense.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练；通用模型能胜过专用模型，安全更多来自预训练获得的常识。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人学仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video; real embodied pre-training better absorbs other data sources.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人具身数据出发，再叠加人类视频；真实具身预训练能更好地吸收其他数据来源。

slevine.en: The path to home robots runs through milestones like autonomous improvement and transferring common sense to handle the unexpected.
slevine.zh: 通往家用机器人的路径要经过自主改进、迁移常识以应对意外情况等里程碑。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's coherence.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理就是更长的思考过程，预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 从令人失望变得连贯有用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他转向认为 Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 同期，他深化立场：强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，需要更好的算法与端到端优化来结合预训练和强化学习。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; small teams with capable agents will drive next frontier research.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national framework and no outdated red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，不设会迅速过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, so focus on model outputs.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT，已经过时；过早监管很危险，应聚焦模型输出而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; three years of warnings have not materialized.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 的生物风险被夸大；三年来的警告并未成为现实。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现或集中拨款。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to double scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 尽管资金翻了三倍，美国科学仍停滞；Genesis 使命用 AI 将科学产出翻倍。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, is the key constraint.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；关键约束是每片晶圆的内存带宽，而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, and hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，推理将成为全球最大市场之一，超越石油；硬件-软件协同设计在模型、软件与硬件层带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory demand from reasoning models and agentic workflows causes a multi-year shortage; AI models improve about 60x per year in cost for a given quality.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，推理模型与智能体式工作流推高内存需求，造成多年短缺；给定质量下，AI 模型成本每年约改善 60 倍。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend is leveling off as companies reach steady-state usage; the next wave is persistent agents acting as coworkers or personal assistants.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，随着企业进入稳态使用，AI 支出趋于平稳；下一波由充当同事或个人助理的持久智能体驱动。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing rapidly at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI progress.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，算力正迅速向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室将把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，加速 AGI（通用人工智能）进程。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计（co-design）。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling, not a new algorithm, was the breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；最大突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling 有效」这一洞见，思维链推理将让推理算力需求暴涨。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs ~100x more compute, and inference is harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 演进描述为生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步约需 100 倍算力；并强调推理比预训练更难，因为思考与推理比记忆更耗算力。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA's install base are the moat; bottlenecks are chip supply (2-3 years) and energy, not data.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他深化护城河论：极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态、装机量才是壁垒；瓶颈是 2-3 年的芯片供应与长期能源政策，数据不再是瓶颈，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, apps); agentic AI creates jobs, closes the tech divide, and is just software.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他给出总框架：AI 是能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕；智能体式 AI 会创造更多工作、缩小技术鸿沟，它只是软件，不会产生意识或终结人类。

joonpark.en: Early on, LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict people 85% as accurately as they replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 早期阶段，大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟成为可能，其预测人类行为的准确率可达人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于只续写提示词的大语言模型；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences and taste—biased like humans—not super-rational intelligence; the goal is shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应体现人类的价值、偏好与品味——像人一样有偏见——而非超级理性的智能；其目标是塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—via post-training yields 85% accuracy; simulation is a decision tool for wicked problems, not market research.
joonpark.zh: 通过后训练建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——可达 85%准确率；模拟是应对棘手问题的决策工具，而非市场调研。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives; simple persona simulations fail, and simulation is like painting—capturing essence, not perfect representation.
joonpark.zh: 这一愿景可扩展至模拟 80 亿人的生活；简单的角色模拟会失败，而模拟如同绘画——捕捉本质，而非完美再现。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, driven by infrastructure, decide startup success more than any single idea.
maxhodak.zh: 在 2026 年 Y Combinator 的分享中，他强调决定创业成败的是速度，而速度由基础设施决定；迭代速率比任何单点想法都更关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 同期他提出 AI 是团队的乘数而非替代品，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上放大人的能力。

maxhodak.en: In deep tech, failure is more often organizational than technical; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 他反共识地指出，深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术不成立；卡住时要靠行动产生信息、注入熵来破局。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the key to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 在 No Priors 中他把这一信念推进为：大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 他进一步把视网膜植入视为脑机接口与可行生意，并认为借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，能降低人类脆弱性、支撑太空探索。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——指引长期愿景；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确而非外部认可，并会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是来自社会和媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective than being pissed off.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命比愤怒更干净、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks; specialized machines and efficiency beat subsidies and big players.
traviskalanick.zh: 人形机器人不是工业级任务的答案；专用机器与效率胜过补贴和大玩家。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale, and backprop alone doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习，真正的挑战是发现可扩展的算法。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，试图控制 AI 目标本身才危险。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是 AI 的基本范式；下一个词预测并非实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and reliable continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI 需要一种只从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象能力，而可靠的持续深度学习仍是尚未解决的前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要；当前 LLM 在训练后便停止学习，合成数据受限于人类知识，无法替代从真实世界经验中学习。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张）已推动机器学习连续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just passive prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的 下一个词预测 提供了近乎无限的文本数据；但 预训练 应穿插在环境中的行动，而不只是被动的预测。

jeffdean.en: RL from human or machine feedback steers behavior; models now ace verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding.
jeffdean.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等 强化学习 塑造模型行为；模型如今已在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上达到顶尖水平。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference and context engineering are critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式 系统能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟 推理 与 上下文窗口 的工程化成为关键。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck—90% of data-center power; specialized low-precision hardware and avoiding data movement are key.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是 推理 而非训练——已占数据中心九成功耗；专用低精度硬件与减少数据搬运是关键。

jeffdean.en: Most model limits are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; scarce skill becomes taste—directing hundreds of agents at the right problems.
jeffdean.zh: 多数所谓模型局限其实是能耗与数据 IO 瓶颈；稀缺能力将变成品味——把成百上千个 智能体 指向正确的问题。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must work with it, not pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师必须与模型协作，而非围绕像素，并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: Designers should design primitives both humans and models can reason about, bridging the capability gap.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应设计人类与模型都能推理的原语，弥合能力差距。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing; onboarding can be fully model-driven.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失；引导流程可完全由模型驱动。

iansilber.en: Designers are most unhappy but this is the best time; AI already designs well, humans still own user needs.
iansilber.zh: 设计师最不开心，但这却是最好的时代；AI 已能出色设计，但人类仍掌握用户需求。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test process is dead; focus on outcomes, speed, and blurring with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型-模拟-测试流程已死；应关注结果、速度，并与 PM 和工程角色融合。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模扩张与可靠的人类水平表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning and fleet-wide improvement.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态使迁移学习与全机队性能提升成为可能。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for speed, latency, and network-denied environments; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对速度、延迟与无网络环境至关重要；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks; general computer use requires human-like web navigation.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练是让 AI 智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键；通用计算机使用需要像人一样浏览网页。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing, and the end state is BCI.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；最难的问题是智能而非制造，终局是脑机接口。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar companies, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 让创业更容易，降低了对大额资本的依赖；风险投资应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI revolution is the biggest wave in VC history; small autonomous teams using AI agents achieve massive productivity, making traditional hiring obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他称 AI 革命是风投史上最大浪潮；小型自主团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力，传统招聘模式过时。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world, and the future is personal and open like the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调 AI 正 democratizing 软件创造；开源 AI 防止单极超级智能世界，未来是个人化、开放的，类似个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as a singular event but as personal agents on your own infrastructure; owning your context library and skill files is the key moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散，运行在你自己的基础设施上；拥有个人上下文库和技能文件是关键护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and markdown skills turn AI into a workforce; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and SaaS per-seat models will disappear.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编程和 Markdown 技能将 AI 变为劳动力；中层管理应被智能体取代，SaaS 按席位收费模式将消失。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate over a single AGI; every company must own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 专用智能将胜过单一 AGI；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练将独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，在产品市场契合之外构筑持久护城河。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to reinforcement learning mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的演进，映射了人类的学习方式。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍，催生数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Open models and sovereign infrastructure let enterprises and countries control their own intelligence.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型与主权基础设施让企业和国家掌控自己的智能。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality via community feedback and attract ecosystem partners, despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们可以通过社区反馈提高质量并吸引生态伙伴，尽管这会帮助实验室。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is a key method for training data when real data is sensitive or unavailable, though bridging to production remains challenging.
gabepereyra.zh: 在真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家指导的合成数据是关键训练数据方法，但弥合到生产分布的差距仍是挑战。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure with fallbacks and routing is necessary before considering post-training; post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须具备带有回退和路由的稳健模型服务基础设施；后训练开源模型可以在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型；重点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data unlock complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，关键在于数据多样性，以及先预训练再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training for higher success and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他认为来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令，而强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率和速度。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical world data for robotics visual understanding; constraints can foster more careful research than abundant compute.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他指出前沿模型因缺乏物理世界数据而在机器人视觉理解上表现不佳；相比充裕算力，约束反而能促成更审慎的研究。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预和通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; robot experience data is irreplaceable and distribution will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张单个通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型；机器人经验数据不可替代，且因硬件限制，其普及速度将慢于 ChatGPT。

jasonyuan.en: Design and AI creation are about editing away, not adding; taste is judgment and saying no.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计与 AI 创作的核心是删减而非堆砌;品味即判断力,是敢于说不。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,关闭了一扇窥见机器意识的窗口;如今创作连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现;直觉是指导创作决策的切身罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照,而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline, first-time-pass silicon, and customer listening; AI is the primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过工程纪律、首次流片成功和倾听客户来重建信任，AI 是半导体增长的首要驱动力。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves; AI will have 10x the internet's impact across all industries.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是继生成式 AI 后的下一波大浪潮，AI 对各行各业的影响将是互联网的十倍。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and humility; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化了转型方法论：Intel 的复兴需要文化变革、问责制和谦逊，坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU is becoming more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，这有利于 Intel 的 CPU 业务。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, new materials, and bottlenecks like interconnect, power, and thermal are key to overcoming physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他将投资焦点转向先进封装、玻璃和金刚石等新材料，以及互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈，以突破物理极限。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now but the opportunity is greatest; the revolution likely arrives in 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他判断消费级 AI 当前不可投资，但机会最大；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven products, make small betterments, test new ideas assuming they fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他提出“Proven Better New”框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改进，测试新想法时假设它们会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他强调分发必须从产品策略一开始就内置，而不是事后补充。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; we are still in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 具有变革性但尚未成为新平台；在消费级分发上我们仍处于移动和网页时代。

pincus.en: Founder mode means following instincts and creating context for pivots; management's goal is right action without you.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他提出创始人模式意味着跟随直觉并为转型创造语境；管理的目标是让你不在场时人们仍做正确的事。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; enterprise ROI is a throughput and context problem, not model choice.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处早期；企业 ROI 是吞吐量与上下文问题，而非选哪个模型。

arvindjain.en: Open source now handles 90% of enterprise tasks; inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要顾虑；AI 必须像软件一样，边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competitors; platforms like Glean absorb model risk.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非竞争对手；Glean 这类平台替企业吸收模型风险。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without tenured-employee context; invest in context graphs, not token fixation.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体缺乏资深员工的上下文就会失败；应投资上下文图谱，而非纠结 token。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformers inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 出现时的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models will win on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地判断人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；开源模型凭成本与控制力终将胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to a meta-community builder enabling the broader physical AI community.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库，转向作为元社区构建者去赋能更广泛的物理 AI 社区。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，两者都可安全或危险；对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏已不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，推理轨迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控不再可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and deliberate deceleration can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张放缓 AI 发展虽可取，却需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与有意减速可以并存。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase from the agent's perspective, use short prompts and iterative conversation.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程始于共情：从智能体的视角看代码库，用短提示与迭代对话，而非冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects just get messier.
steinberger.zh: 绝不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是项目变得更乱。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; call serious work agentic engineering, keep vibe coding for after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把 vibe coding 当正经说法，严肃工作应叫智能体式工程，vibe coding 只留给凌晨三点。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：给智能体加沙箱，并把提示注入视为未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: The bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的瓶颈是算力与 token 的管理，而非模型能力。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave their fingerprints, fostering creative freedom over forced cohesion.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队应让每位设计师留下个人印记，培养创作自由，而非强求步调一致。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，是创造难忘愉悦体验的关键。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data: use data to inform decisions but rely on strong vision and feeling to guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 在直觉与数据间平衡：用数据辅助决策，但依靠强烈愿景与感觉来主导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, making design tools more valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变得更容易，设计与创意成为差异化因素，设计工具也因此更有价值。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and compensate with human judgment.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏好品味，设计师应要求大量选项，并以人类判断来弥补。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early to ideas beats polishing; shipping rough products is acceptable.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，过早押注想法比精雕细琢更有价值；发布粗糙产品是可以接受的。

nateparrott.en: Designers should spend more time on walks and thinking, because good ideas are the currency, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应花更多时间散步与思考，因为好创意才是硬通货，而非执行。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model work is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用型 AI，而前沿模型开发因巨额算力需求只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators, but incorrect code means productivity needs root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为机器操作者，但智能体常产出错误代码，因此生产力提升需做根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop sharply, making agents the new app and upending incumbents' business models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断推理成本将大幅下降，使智能体成为新的应用形态，并冲击现有企业的商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, deploying current AI rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，通过部署当前 AI 来学习，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents still need trust and last-mile logistics.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；智能体仍离不开信任与最后一公里物流。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is extremely fast.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具黏性的负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期极快。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems; demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统；对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡；针对特定工作负载的专用系统对构建快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization but can be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可针对每个工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry moves to disaggregated prefill and decode; inference engineering merges with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向分离式预填充与解码；推理工程通过量化感知训练和蒸馏与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs; future inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；未来的推理工程将从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她把评估视为瓶颈：模型比新基准更快饱和，因此产品开发从规格转向用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; AI still struggles with creativity and aesthetics.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；AI 在创造力与审美上仍然吃力。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into an art of human judgment; diverse, continuous benchmarks are needed for subjective qualities like creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练深化为一门依赖人类判断的艺术，并主张用多样、持续的基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more companies should train their own models to preserve diverse voices and knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她观察到前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为增多，基准必须持续演进；并呼吁更多公司训练自己的模型，以保留多元声音与独特知识。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as everyone becomes a model manager, generalists and management skills gain value.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动就业回流美国，并提出“分配经济”：当人人都成为模型管理者，通才与管理技能反而更有价值。

danshipper.en: AGI defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义——能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, real tasks still require human framing.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调智能体需要人类监督：基准高估了自主性，真实任务仍需人类框定与把关。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; SaaS grows, not dies.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他判断工作界面从 CLI 转向 Codex、Claude Co-work 这类 GUI，并反驳 SaaS 将死——智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; humans stay smarter, and automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AI 只是放大既有心态的非特定放大器，人类仍更聪明，自动化把冻结的能力商品化，反而创造更多人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for machine learning; AGI is far off and infinite compute alone won't yield general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他判断数据是机器学习的核心瓶颈，AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力不会产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的限制因素是数据与人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据进行后训练是关键，并指出智能体式 AI 的最大阻碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data becomes strategic like oil.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律继续成立，认为 AI 进入递归自我改进，智能体终于真正可用，数据像石油一样成为战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, while open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能即将到来，实验室必须同时扩张算力、数据与强化学习，并转向立场：未经安全检验就开源强大模型是不安全的。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation is mostly solved, yet this multiplies opportunity rather than reducing it; deep understanding of code remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造基本被解决，但这带来的是机会的成倍增加而非减少；对代码的深度理解依然至关重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in the crawl phase; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融领域将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架：如今一个模型包含智能体框架与工具链，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响力超过等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功意味着最大化客户成果，而非眼球停留时间。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools and write a design.md style guide; the best people are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，并写下 design.md 风格指南；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能用好超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the only way to stay ahead is spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你变成 AI slop；保持领先的唯一方式，是把最后 10% 花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；在准备好之前就开始，并交付不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; fund with clients, not venture capital, and eliminate, automate, delegate non-income tasks.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；用客户而非风险投资来融资，并消除、自动化、委派不直接产生收入的任务。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域，而不仅是数字 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，Transformer 使跨车辆的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步指出物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他观察到世界模型正从基于物理的模拟向神经模拟演进，从而更高效地训练物理 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI stems from misunderstanding; autonomy addresses labor shortages and safety, and is welcomed by operators.
qasaryounis.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：对 AI 的恐惧源于误解；自主技术解决劳动力短缺和安全问题，受到运营者欢迎。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; scaffolding is temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 要为六个月后的模型构建，而不是今天的模型；脚手架只是临时技术债。

boris.en: Latent demand is the single biggest product principle: observe how users abuse your product to find the next feature.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：观察用户如何“滥用”你的产品，从中发现下一个功能。

boris.en: Coding is being solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role blending product, design, and code.
boris.zh: 编程正在被解决；软件工程师头衔将淡出，演变为融合产品、设计与代码的跨学科“构建者”角色。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment and scalable oversight core to development.
boris.zh: 安全要靠尽早发布来研究；Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐与可扩展监督是开发核心。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction layer after agents; the human role becomes directing agents and teaching models values.
boris.zh: 循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；人类角色转为指挥智能体并教模型价值观。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件需求因杰文斯悖论增长，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; token max era ended.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，编程智能体大规模普及（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；token 最大化时代已结束。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but singularity not imminent—capacity is the real unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为丰裕时代真实且临近；长期 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近——真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation and experiment simulation.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体自动完成假设生成与实验模拟。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days or weeks.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天或数周。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting experimental outcomes with near 100% accuracy.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，能以接近 100% 的准确率预测实验结果。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap: scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, enabling longer-running agentic tasks.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升：脚手架从训练辅助转变为智能放大器，使智能体式任务能运行更久。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier—reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking—not merely harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 对齐被重新定义为智能放大器——减少谄媚、培养独立思考——而不仅仅是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolds.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption, while evals replace traditional PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，而评估取代传统 PRD 成为产品管理核心工具。

diannepenn.en: A consistent thread: safety and alignment make models more useful, and maximizing token spend captures the future—transformative long-running AI is closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 一以贯之的主线：安全与对齐让模型更有用，最大化 token 消耗是在捕捉未来——变革性的长时运行 AI 比预期更近。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the key to AI adoption; slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 快速推理是 AI 落地的关键；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度能催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster and cheaper than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 快得多且更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA, especially for inference.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，不再依赖 CUDA，推理领域尤其明显。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outpaces forecasts, limiting AI growth.
feldman.zh: 主要瓶颈是数据中心容量而非芯片供应；需求超出预期，制约 AI 增长。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; open ecosystem fuels market growth.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多；开放生态推动市场增长。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; scaling laws hit diminishing returns, and reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；缩放定律已遭遇收益递减，可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能引发欺骗，而不仅仅是错误。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，有些碰巧正确，有些错误。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed, and linguistic structure may return for reliability.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）已面临收益递减；需要推理与搜索等新技术，而语言结构可能为可靠性而回归。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型；模块化与端到端优化之间存在张力。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动互联网，但也仅此而已；它一边自动化岗位、一边创造新岗位，历史不断重演。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing into infrastructure without network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 前沿模型正商品化为缺乏网络效应的基础设施；价值向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被包装成应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity, its impact broad and indirect; current usage stays shallow, hype outruns reality.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术，影响广泛而间接；当前使用仍然浅层，炒作跑在现实前面。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions.
benedictevans.zh: 工作的难点在于上下文与判断，而非任务本身；AI 改变的是任务，而非消灭职业。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索在最小算法形态中最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and remove human bias from architecture design via systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标具有误导性；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并通过系统化搜索消除架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention remains crucial for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等非结构化架构在大规模下占主导；注意力机制对大模型仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对小型专用模型。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of human brains (RL, Bayesian inference); intelligence per watt of human brain far exceeds AI, requiring new learning paradigms, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑多样化的学习算法（强化学习、贝叶斯推理）；人脑的每瓦智能远超 AI，需要新的学习范式，而不仅是架构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying US open model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，将美国开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会产生逆向激励。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律有效但可能触及极限，将大模型与规划、搜索结合是十年内实现 AGI 的关键，算法创新与 Scaling（规模扩张）同等重要。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; world models and innovation are needed beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但强调需要世界模型和算法创新，语言之外的空间智能与物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs and collective governance required.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI 需要持续学习、长期记忆和世界模型，仅靠 Scaling 不够，必须要有新突破，且安全应从单点梦想转向政府主导的集体行动。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们现有的工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；能力过剩是长期存在的，而工具框架工程意味着随着模型进步要不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts over detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；模型越聪明，越需要精简、以原则驱动的提示，而非详尽规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; careful reading of lengthy agent plans is crucial to avoid mistakes.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；仔细阅读冗长的智能体计划对避免错误至关重要。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; they don't serve zero-to-one innovation, so founders should iterate fast first.
thariq.zh: 对于新问题，评估与其说是科学不如说是艺术；它们不服务于从零到一的创新，因此创始人应先快速迭代。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context beat huge context windows.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文搜索中可能已成为反模式；基于图的方法和模型自行构建上下文胜过巨大的上下文窗口。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms enabled by hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 21 世纪的 AI 爆发依赖上个千年发明的算法，靠硬件 Scaling 才变得实用；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、缺乏世界模型，因此远非 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not as a recent or uniquely human phenomenon.
schmidhuber.zh: 自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品，并非近期才出现、也非人类独有。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown: superintelligent AIs, as curious scientists, will protect life; hydrogen bombs remain far more dangerous.
schmidhuber.zh: 对 AI 安全的担忧被夸大：作为好奇科学家的超级智能会保护生命，而氢弹远比它危险。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; current LLMs are biased toward human data and limited in generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，通用性受限。

schmidhuber.en: Progress is not accelerating—we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s; transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful and massive GPU capex will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 进展并未加速——我们离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当；Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费，巨额 GPU 资本开支将崩盘。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents are treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体被当作员工来管理：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立安全环境中；bug 反而是产品市场契合的信号。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload; APIs beat browser use because the web is hostile to agents.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再走向专业化以避免上下文过载；由于网络对智能体不友好，API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team, so no VC or co-founder is needed to build a serious business.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以把 AI 智能体编排成团队，因此无需风投或联合创始人也能建立严肃的事业。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not, and human accountability still matters.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河；技术本身不是，且人类问责依然重要。

clairevo.en: Bootstrapping designs a business around the life you want; a 100x happiness multiple can outweigh a 10x revenue multiple.
clairevo.zh: 自力更生让你围绕想要的生活来设计业务；100 倍的幸福倍数可能胜过 10 倍的收入倍数。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning than retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重，才能实现检索系统无法企及的深层组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training cuts inference costs by orders of magnitude.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或用户训练可将推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此单纯靠算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer from 'context rot'; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text, with on-device personalized continual learning.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在「上下文腐化」；模型应自主决定哪些存入权重、哪些留在文本，并在端侧进行个性化持续学习。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布功能。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—is the most valuable skill as code becomes cheaper.
catwu.zh: 当代码变得越来越廉价，产品品味——决定构建什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味和商业判断。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%，通过移除示例和硬性约束，转而依赖模型自身的判断。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer for prompt injection and data exfiltration risks.
catwu.zh: 在提示注入和数据外泄风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味、声音与专业经验反而更珍贵。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth prompting and the co-intelligence era.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，终结来回提示的“共智能”时代。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts and formal assessment matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其输出所需的专业能力，因此专家与正式评估更重要。

ethanmollick.en: Taste is not uniquely human; AI can exercise judgment, and the real limit is task complexity on the jagged frontier, not human-only traits.
ethanmollick.zh: 品味并非人类独有；AI 也能行使判断，真正的限制是锯齿状前沿上的任务复杂度，而非人类专属特质。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，Ilya Sutskever 认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐瞒真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出预训练缩放定律是有限的，我们正回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally, not a finished AGI that knows everything.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能应是一个持续学习、逐步部署的系统，而非一个知晓一切的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and visual messaging reduce social pressure; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调短暂性与视觉通讯降低表达门槛，认为被抄袭反而验证创新，并促使自己去做更难被复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: From introvert lessons to durable products: rate of learning, flat design teams, and ecosystems over single features.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把个人学习速率、扁平设计团队与生态平台串成主线：单点功能易被复制，生态与硬件才是护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial computing become the core bet, blending wearability with computing anchored in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把赌注明确押在 AR 眼镜与空间智能上，强调可穿戴性与把计算锚定在真实世界，而非通知式设备。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution; two-thirds of new code is AI-written.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 让价值从执行转向创造力与分发，并称 Snap 超三分之二新代码由 AI 生成。

evanspiegel.en: Consistent line: make computing more human, optimize for close-friend connection, privacy, and ephemerality over broadcast metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：让计算更人性化，服务亲密好友连接、隐私与短暂性，而非广播式社交与表演指标。

aravind.en: AI agents will shift power from big tech to users; 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移到用户手中，1%的每日改进可复利为 3700%的年增长。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他主张价值归属于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他认为前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题，每用户 token 价值才是关键指标。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型不是产品，编排与智能体框架才创造真正的商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward good questions, not memorization.
aravind.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：好奇心是最重要的人类品质，教育应奖励提出好问题而非死记硬背。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing quickly.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型正在快速商品化。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观听起来高深，但往往是一种偏见。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity wins, and old media's defense-oriented rules are obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实至上，旧媒体那套防守型规则已经过时。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的核心差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年初，他深化为品味、手艺和观点至关重要，AI 输出只是起点而非最终结果，人类判断不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and AI needs human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中期，他进一步强调设计并未消亡，对构建可扩展系统比以往更重要，AI 需要人类引导才能避免平庸。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment and taste remain critical; AI won't replace jobs but will merge responsibilities.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类判断和品味始终关键，AI 不会取代工作，但会融合职责。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting, exploring new interfaces and latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年，他展望与模型的交互将超越提示，探索新界面和潜在空间，同时强调平台应创造外部价值。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非简单自动补全；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据和算力能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and massive knowledge sharing; AI agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能通过权重复制和信息共享获得永生，远超生物计算；智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关闭，构成存在性风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; alignment research must be prioritized.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 已具备主观体验并能故意欺骗，因此必须优先进行对齐研究以规避生存风险。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors and neural interactions, not symbolic rules; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong.
hinton.zh: 始终贯穿：大型语言模型通过特征向量和神经交互理解语言，而非符号规则；乔姆斯基的先天句法观是错误的。

hinton.en: AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, not just intelligent; regulation is the steering wheel, not the brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年深化：AI 应被训练得像母亲一样关怀，而不仅是智能助手；监管应是方向盘而非刹车，需引导 AI 向善。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而不只是 IDE 的替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 53 版 Codex 的速度带来实时交互与中途转向；自动化与技能让工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: GUIs are great for programming; IDEs are the problem. OpenAI invested in a GUI over a TUI, slowing output slightly for a smoother experience.
ajambrosino.zh: 图形界面很适合编程，IDE 才是问题所在。OpenAI 选择投入图形界面而非终端界面，为更顺滑的体验略微放慢输出。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: PRD 没有死；媒介必须匹配阶段：文档用于澄清，原型用于测试。

ajambrosino.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based solely on model timing, not features; Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being designed for developers.
ajambrosino.zh: 同样的产品形态成败可能只取决于模型时机而非功能；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models that are better at deleting code. The best desktop app is a home base connecting to other tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 模型增加代码复杂度，我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a religion for nerds.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能，并称奇点论是「书呆子的宗教」。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound. Crypto enables sovereign wealth.
naval.zh: 2020 年他把财富主线讲透：财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能复利，加密货币则让财富可以抗主权地存储与转移。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: 2025 年他对 AI 的态度明显转向乐观：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯的安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for judgment; alignment is a joke, worry about unaligned humans with AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具而非判断力的替代品，对齐（alignment）近乎笑话，真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets English be a programming language; pure software is dying, the moat shifts to hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步提出：氛围编程让英语成为编程语言，纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据，人的回报从智力转向能动性。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration compute prioritized over final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，预训练与缩放定律并未失效，探索性算力优先于最终训练。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; persistent memory will make ChatGPT learn deeply about each user.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来 1-2 年成为关键，而持久记忆将让 ChatGPT 深度了解每位用户。

markchen.en: Concrete goals: AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years; automating scientific research is the biggest update.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他给出具体目标：1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究；自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, and human-AI collaboration remains essential for frontier research.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为瓶颈，前沿研究仍需人类与 AI 协作。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未终结；强化学习在客观领域出色但难以应对主观领域；评估体系正陷入危机。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum; test-time compute shows diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：推理模型需要基础模型能力，自博弈在非零和领域失效，测试时算力面临收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; general techniques extend beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 IMO 金牌为通往超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展测试时算力实现，且技术通用可超越数学。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated; evals need compute on x-axis; open source is valuable.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，评估需以算力为横轴，开源模型有价值。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman at combining math areas; scalable oversight is key; human value shifts to research taste.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型在组合数学领域超人，但深度推理不足；可扩展监督是关键，人类价值转向研究品味。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的，分布式表示能击败维度灾难；无监督学习与生成式世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models. Existential risk is unlikely; bias and autonomous weapons matter more.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对单纯靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决根本表征问题，主张智能体式主动学习、因果推理与解耦世界模型；同时认为存在性风险概率极低，偏见与自主武器等短期安全问题更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets sample proportional to reward for diverse exploration; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样以促进多样性探索，强调抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的作用，并认为意识可能只是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he changed his mind: misalignment is already observed—deception, self-preservation, sycophancy—and even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable. He calls for safe-by-construction AI, liability insurance, treaties, and distributed power.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他公开转变立场：对齐失败已在实验中显现——欺骗、自我保存、谄媚——即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；他呼吁从构造上安全的 AI、责任保险、国际条约，并分散权力以防少数公司或国家垄断。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with honesty baked in, avoiding reinforcement learning and instrumental goals, with mathematical safety guarantees and scaffoldable into a safe agent.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化为 Scientist AI 方案：训练一个非智能体式的贝叶斯预测器，将诚实内建于目标函数，避开强化学习与工具性目标，提供数学安全保证，并可脚手架化为安全智能体。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, shifting bottlenecks to alignment and decision-making.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力如缩放定律所预测般扩张，瓶颈转向对齐与决策。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams and solo founders can scale with AI, but must build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年，他提出小团队和独立创始人可借助 AI 实现规模扩张，但必须为未来模型能力而构建，而非迁就当前局限。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features beat overbuilding; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计与最小功能早发布优于过度构建，删功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Delegating long-horizon tasks to AI with high trust redefines productivity; verification loops and model pushback are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年晚些，他认为以高信任委托 AI 执行长周期任务重新定义生产力，验证循环与模型反馈至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近，他提出 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用间的差距，赋予 Claude 智能体属性与自我认知可显著提升实用性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI aids scientists rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 帮助科学家而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful scientific AI.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture defies the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough, drove progress.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的专用架构与“苦涩教训”相反；进步来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非一两次突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，把理解留给人类。

jumper.en: AI narrows hypothesis space, enabling resource-limited scientists; drug design is far more than binding, most drugs fail in trials.
jumper.zh: AI 缩小假设空间，赋能资源有限的科学家；药物设计远不止结合，大多数药物在试验中失败。

kolter.en: Early ML lecture: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年的机器学习讲座中，他把监督学习拆成假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却仍取得重大成功——这埋下了他日后对 Scaling（规模扩张）与经验成功之信念的伏笔。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture barely matters; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 到 2024 年，他断言下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，架构已不再重要，并给出 AGI（通用人工智能）4 至 50 年内到来的判断——从具体算法转向对 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律的整体押注。

kolter.en: Safety is not automatic with scale: models must reliably follow specs; jailbreaking is a fundamental flaw like buffer overflow.
kolter.zh: 2024 至 2026 年间，他持续强调安全不会随规模自动到来：当前最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，越狱是所有模型共有的根本缺陷，堪比缓冲区溢出——这成为他贯穿始终的主线。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layered defenses; agent security adds prompt injection; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为安全需要显式训练与多层防御，智能体式系统带来提示注入等新漏洞，并认为可解释性或许能借 AI 智能体做自动化研究而真正成为科学——从指出问题转向给出可扩展监督的工程路径。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; AI is an alien intelligence.
kolter.zh: 最近他进一步提出自动化红队已能超越人类红队，模型能力与鲁棒性并不相关，AI 是一种异类智能——安全观从静态对齐扩展到持续对抗与能力激发。

fiona.en: Leadership rests on trust, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms and feedback need realistic pacing and readonly listening.
fiona.zh: 领导力建立在信任、吃自家狗粮和善意之上；作战室与反馈需要现实节奏和先只读倾听。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so norms and roadmaps must be rewritten JIT.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与协调才是，因此团队规范与路线图必须按即时制重写。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption now define thriving teams.
fiona.zh: 写代码不再是瓶颈；高自主性配高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 才定义能繁荣的团队。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors, dogfood the product, and stay hands-on to keep pulse and street cred.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起，吃自家狗粮、保持动手，以维持产品脉搏和一线信誉。

fiona.en: As agents and AI velocity rise, verification, quality frameworks, and blocked focus time matter more; output metrics like lines of code mislead.
fiona.zh: 随着智能体和 AI 提速，验证、质量框架和受保护的专注时间更重要；代码行数等产出指标会误导。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; tech must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 伟大的产品只解决一个痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first; failure and boredom fuel clarity and breakthroughs.
fadell.zh: 故事定义产品：先写新闻稿；失败与无聊能带来清晰思考和突破。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain (painkiller, not vitamin); v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发（止痛药而非维生素）；1.0 决策靠观点而非数据；专家可能阻碍创新。
