fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and humans in the loop; AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文和人类在环；AI 可穿戴设备将是一组联邦式设备，而非单一设备。

fadell.en: Hardware plus software and deep tech endure; don't chase hype; ethics and avoiding addiction matter.
fadell.zh: 软硬件结合与深度技术更具持久力；不追逐炒作；伦理与避免成瘾至关重要。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, balancing data with feeling and trust.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人未言明的需求；直觉是一种智能，需与数据、感受和信任相平衡。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer, and technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；大自然是最好设计师，技术应放大而非剥离我们的人性。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid decision guides, complementing rational analysis and subconscious data processing.
ivyross.zh: 直觉与身体感受是有效的决策指引，补充理性分析与潜意识的信息处理。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下繁荣；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable and design leadership more business-savvy.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意技能更有价值，设计领导层更懂商业。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space are the next breakthrough.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫智能；抽象表征空间中的世界模型是下一个突破。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven AI with world models and hierarchical planning is the safe, scalable path.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有世界模型与分层规划的目标驱动 AI 才是安全、可扩展的路径。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做他们重视的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency matters, and CEOs must understand token capital.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率很重要，CEO 必须理解 token 资本。

satya.en: The future of work involves humans and agents co-creating tacit knowledge; security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical.
satya.zh: 工作的未来涉及人类与智能体共同创造隐性知识；安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 的最佳实现方式是让企业爬坡，而非构建防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公开反馈对对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: From iterative deployment to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration replaces turn-based AI, keeping humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 从迭代部署到交互模型：实时、高带宽的协作取代回合制 AI，让人类始终参与其中。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定。

murati.en: Compressing frontier AI progress leads to volatility; durable progress requires long-term, human-in-the-loop development.
murati.zh: 压缩前沿模型进展会导致波动；持久进步需要长期、人类参与的开发。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence in math; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and reliable AI.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法在数学上达到超级智能；形式化验证对于可靠证明和可靠 AI 至关重要。

carinahong.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency; formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成带来性能提升和样本效率；形式化验证是为了 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越性，而不仅仅是消除错误。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging and lacks grounding.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战且缺乏基础。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; AI proofs can converge to human-like intuition when streamlined.
carinahong.zh: 即使 AI 能证明定理，人类品味和直觉仍然至关重要；AI 证明经过精简后可以收敛到类人直觉。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification should enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical industries.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化验证应超越安全关键行业，促进开放协作。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; LLMs are next-token predictors, and intelligence is compression via Scaling.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；同时指出大语言模型本质是下一个词预测，智能可视为压缩，而 Scaling（规模扩张）的惊人之处在于简单性。

gustav.en: Transformer solved context; fine-tuning and RLHF insert human values; AI creativity is randomized likely tokens, not true understanding.
gustav.zh: 同年他深入技术层：Transformer 解决了上下文窗口问题，微调与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把一小群人的价值观注入模型；AI 的创造力只是在高概率词附近随机化，并非真正理解。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, and inference marginal cost will force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业必须重构基础设施才能冲浪，否则被淘汰；并强调 AI 推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，而非传统软件逻辑。

gustav.en: Expose company data via APIs and MCP so non-developers use AI tools; Spotify is the music industry's R&D department.
gustav.zh: 他提出通过 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 Cursor 等 AI 工具；同时把 Spotify 定位为音乐行业的研发部门，用利润反哺增长。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control over algorithms in plain English; strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement, with synchronized swimming leadership.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他深化为生成式 AI 应让用户用自然语言控制算法、个性化体验，而非更上瘾；战略上坚持“时间花得值”优先于参与度指标，并以同步游泳而非分而治之的模式领导公司。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但采用思维链与强化学习的推理模型如今每单位算力带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; progress is a smooth exponential, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: AI 放缓论是错误的；进展是平滑的指数增长，尽管前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling; focus shifts to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术极限，拖慢了预训练规模扩张；焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with reinforcement learning and tools solves hard problems but still needs vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 结合强化学习与工具的推理能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Multimodal models haven't made deep progress; they still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches, lagging behind text.
kaiser.zh: 多模态模型尚未取得深层进展；它们仍像小块一样顺序处理输入，落后于文本。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling, not algorithms alone; Google's conservatism and ad model slowed its AI launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他主张 AI 进步更多由算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动、比人们想的更可预测，而非只靠算法；并批评 Google 因保守和广告模式错失先发。

suleyman.en: Existential risk is infinitesimally small; containment is hard as models shrink; open-source AI is meritocratic, not just risky.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他淡化 AI 生存风险，认为其微乎其微；同时强调模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，并把开源 AI 视为缩小不平等的力量而非单纯风险。

suleyman.en: Near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI welfare; companions should set boundaries; containment must precede alignment for superintelligence.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他把近期最大危险转向人们把意识投射给 AI，主张 AI 伴侣应设边界而非谄媚；并开始强调在超级智能前必须先遏制、再对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate to humans; no race to AGI; containment first, then alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为“人本超级智能”：超级智能必须始终服务于人类、从属于人类；不存在通往 AGI 的零和竞赛，遏制优先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models self-sufficiently; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months; consumer value lags enterprise.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张微软须自建前沿模型实现自给；白领任务将在 12 至 18 个月内被自动化而非消灭整个职业，且企业端产品市场契合度比消费端更清晰。

mensch.en: Small open models can match big ones; data quality beats raw compute, and open scrutiny makes AI safer.
mensch.zh: 2023 年：小模型也能有出色表现，数据质量比单纯堆算力更重要；开源带来的广泛审视让 AI 更安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality matter, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI needs control of data, infrastructure and values, and augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年：应拥抱 AI 而非恐惧；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 是增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents, and AGI as one system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for AI autonomy; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：欧洲只有两年窗口建立 AI 自主权；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革，而非模型智能。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process are Jobs' true legacy.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向更亲密的可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与珍视才是乔布斯的真正遗产。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose; simplicity expresses essence, and joy and humanity are essential, not trivial.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动；简约是表达本质，快乐与人性不可或缺，而非琐碎。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's first EV is a deliberate risky bet to redefine the brand; authenticity means no fake engine sounds, and performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利首款电动车是重新定义品牌的有意冒险；真实意味着不伪造引擎声，性能是多维的。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on local computer access and shared tools; scaffolding may matter less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否访问本地计算机和共享工具；随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; building prototypes beats writing specs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化；构建原型胜过写规格说明。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks; the biggest gap is people not realizing AI can solve almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务；最大的差距是人们没有意识到 AI 几乎能解决任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus for unclear asks; live artifacts enable auto-refreshing dashboards.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，需求不清晰时用 Opus；实时工件可实现自动刷新的仪表盘。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响判断；理想的交互是异步的。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics: batch size trades latency vs cost; memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学：批大小权衡延迟与成本；长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存内存但存在质量限制；最优批大小取决于稀疏率而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; API pricing reveals architecture like KV head count.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；API 定价揭示 KV 头数等架构细节。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; caching tiers likely use flash and spinning disk, not HBM or DDR.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；缓存层级可能使用闪存和机械盘，而非 HBM 或 DDR。

reinerpope.en: AI chips: multiply-accumulate is the primitive; data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; low precision is far more efficient due to quadratic bit-width scaling.
reinerpope.zh: AI 芯片：乘加运算是基本原语；即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；由于位宽二次缩放，低精度效率远更高。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to Gemini; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 Gemini，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，因此算法创新与推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math, though clean reward signals are hard to obtain.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级增长的算力；后训练强化学习在编程和数学之外仍是潜力巨大的处女地，尽管干净的奖励信号难以获得。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities, and the bitter lesson favors general systems.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力，而苦涩的教训表明通用系统终将胜出。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他指出，传统设计流程在 AI 工具面前已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应当信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: By 2026 he declares the research-diverge-converge process dead: mock-up time drops to 30-40%, vision shortens to 3-6 months, and designers must help engineers ship.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他宣告“研究—发散—收敛”流程已死：画稿时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，设计视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月，设计师必须帮工程师落地而非只交付稿子。

jennywen.en: He deepens this into three archetypes—block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, cracked new grads—arguing taste alone won't save designers; judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 他进一步深化为三种设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、白纸型新人，并强调仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力与权威才是关键。

jennywen.en: He keeps a consistent thread: put work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle, and let designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 他始终贯穿着一条主线：把作品与用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期，并让设计师自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度。

jennywen.en: His stance hardens: speed is not improvement, 'everyone is using it' is no design argument, and designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 他的立场愈发坚定：速度不等于进步，“大家都在用”不是设计论据，设计师独特的价值在于与模糊性共处。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性，而非模型本身的产物，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL; data quality beats algorithm choice, and RLVR emerges for reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择更重要，并看到 RLVR 成为后训练最大突破，催生推理与思维链行为。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese labs dominate via strategic openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明，而非仅开放权重；并指出中国实验室凭借战略开放性主导开源生态。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; RLVR is the biggest breakthrough.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling；RLVR 是最大突破，同时警惕 Qwen 数据污染可能夸大结果。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of research, but lag closed frontier by 6-9 months; the gap may persist or widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但最佳开源模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，且这一差距可能持续甚至扩大；中国实验室在算力约束下工程执行强但范式创新少。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他视 Transformer 为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可经蒸馏缩到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; decade of agents, not year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存，提示词是程序；这是智能体的十年，而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak, synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习很弱，合成数据会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate code to agents, automate research; outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：把编码交给智能体、自动化研究；可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and builds intelligence.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的核心缺口，无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，是通向通用智能的关键。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs sample efficiency and dynamic, not quasi-static, skills.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励并不现实，真实世界的机器人学习需要样本效率与动态技能，而非准静态动作。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; with no internet of robot data, we must combine video, simulation, and real-world data.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终把机器人学视为数据问题：既然没有机器人数据的互联网，就必须整合视频、仿真与真实世界数据。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出一个通用大脑——如同语言领域的 ChatGPT——可驱动任何形态的机器人，配方是多样化数据预训练加真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment, not software-style scaling, is the primary challenge; robotics cannot succeed overnight and needs rigorous real-world testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：部署而非软件式的规模扩张才是首要挑战，机器人无法一夜成功，需要严格的真实世界测试。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待模型；成本很低，且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating novel existence; human psychology analogies are insufficient and can breed insecurity.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对其全新的存在方式；简单套用人类心理学类比并不足够，还可能滋生不安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；拥有良好特质的核心身份可以适应局部角色。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, explicit guidance should give way to judgment; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，显式指导应让位于判断力；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial; respect and care avoid breeding resentment in future advanced AI.
askell.zh: 关于 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明度至关重要；尊重与关怀可避免在未来先进 AI 中滋生怨恨。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; scaling and world models enable generalization and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码系统；Scaling（规模扩张）与世界模型带来泛化与涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Modern interpretability tools make end-to-end neural nets interpretable today, overturning past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 现代可解释性工具让端到端神经网络在今天已可解释，颠覆了过去的看法。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; pure learning is cleaner.
kendall.zh: 规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好；纯学习路径更干净。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将比 Robotaxi 更快上量；跨 500+ 城市的零样本泛化是可能的。

carlpei.en: Survival is the core value; startups must pace themselves, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值；初创公司必须把握节奏、从简单产品起步，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心，而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; the future is applied AI, agentic software, and generative UI, not major hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 硬件艰难且利润最低；未来在于应用型 AI、智能体式软件与生成式 UI，而非硬件的重大改变。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a hype topic.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型正走向商品化与价格战；AI 应作为提升实用性的配料，而不是炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; focus on differentiation, not product-market fit.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是最快的差异化手段；应聚焦差异化，而非产品市场契合。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，由主动式智能体执行任务；只有脑机接口能取代它，而非眼镜。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速 AI 进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks in real-world use.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他指出自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 努力实现的重要里程碑，治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is insufficient.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现，仅靠强化学习不够。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为思维链监控是关键对齐工具，在产品中隐藏思维链以保持其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化，模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation are the real bottlenecks for AI progress, not benchmarks or scale alone.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步真正的瓶颈，而非基准测试或单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）可能还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 和下一个词预测可能无法实现，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Models will diverge based on labs' objective functions; every company should eventually train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化观点：模型将因实验室的目标函数不同而分化，最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety must be prioritized over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他将视角延伸至医学：AI 的幻觉使人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先于准确，而遗漏是重大风险。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; chat is not the future interface—it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的；聊天不是未来的界面——它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate on it like software, shipping daily to learn what users need, and let emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样迭代，每天发布以了解用户需求，让涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开；前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and can take actions, amplifying human capability.
turley.zh: 愿景是个人化 AI 助手，了解你的目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动，放大人类能力。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends from protein structures to biomolecular interactions; GraphCast, GNOME, FunSearch, AlphaGeometry show AI's broad scientific reach.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到生物分子相互作用；GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 展现 AI 广泛的科学触角。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 LLM 幻觉在搭配真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；必须迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can go beyond human knowledge; verifiable domains like code are crucial.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手，说明 AI 能超越人类知识；代码等可验证领域至关重要。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human data; interpretability matters but is not essential for breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练与强化学习是突破人类数据的关键；可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 式突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通用智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video, not just teleoperation, can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 从视频而非仅遥操作数据中学习，能在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; diversity and inclusion are essential to beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；多样性与包容对构建有益 AI 至关重要。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；安全仍是一个未解问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind—it leapfrogs legacy issues, and language models can transform local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲并未落后——它跨越了历史包袱，语言模型能变革本地语言教育。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and code, not Figma libraries, to ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉的模式与代码（而非 Figma 组件库）以快速交付。

henrymodisett.en: Not every surface needs perfection; chase ROI on what to make great, and let products grow powerful without feeling complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 并非每个界面都要做到完美；把精力投在值得做好的地方，让产品在变强的同时不让人觉得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把决策权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: Brand signals quality and attracts talent; people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌传递品质并吸引人才；人们加入的是品牌而非公司，所以要尽早投入品牌建设。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作，不必拘泥于固定结构。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed, and coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构，而编程是领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; longer agentic coherence and compute bottlenecks will define the next phase.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的；更长的智能体式连贯性与算力瓶颈将定义下一阶段。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排与工具更重要；世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她认为预训练赋予广泛知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models with better inference algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她指出下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位；借助更好的推理算法，更小的模型也能在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge, not transcend it. RL needs careful engineering.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她深化为：数据是根本瓶颈，当前方法只是插值人类知识而非超越；强化学习需要精心设计才能超越监督微调。

yejin.en: Open research and collaboration are crucial to compete with closed frontier labs; abductive reasoning is key to scientific discovery.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她强调开放研究与跨机构合作对抗衡闭源前沿模型至关重要；溯因推理是科学发现的关键。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张用高质量、多样化的合成数据让小语言模型媲美前沿模型；多元对齐比试图消除互联网偏见更可行。

yejin.en: RL as a pre-training objective improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive; AI for science must go beyond human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她提出将强化学习作为预训练目标，通过奖励信息增益提升推理能力，尽管算力昂贵；AI for science 必须超越人类已有知识。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL is a cherry on top, unsupervised learning does most work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，能实现大规模并行化和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：数据是机器人领域的主要瓶颈，通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调构建简单、端到端、能利用多样数据源的机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是重大挑战。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预测进步；测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚不十分实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程正从代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Taste and logic design skills become more valuable than carefulness; AI shift exceeds the internet.
truell.zh: 品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎更宝贵；AI 变革将超越互联网。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills and prioritize alignment research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，应优先培养技能并聚焦对齐研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning and simulation ensembles; RL lacks long-horizon credit assignment, but tennis robot is feasible.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人打网球可行，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配，需要分层推理；仿真集成比单一精确模拟器更利于现实迁移。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should guide data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向强调无监督学习与强化学习结合提升样本效率，先验知识应指导数据生成而非硬编码，预训练语言模型可迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent focus on transfer learning and fine-tuning large pre-trained models, from robotics to general reasoning patterns.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终关注迁移学习与微调大型预训练模型，从机器人技能快速习得到通用推理模式的迁移。

abbeel.en: Reliability (99.9%) is the benchmark for warehouse robotics; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出 99.9% 可靠性是仓储机器人创造真实价值的基准，单个神经网络可跨任务和末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: Human brain generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终认为人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实世界中会失败。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque like alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他强调 LLM 基于下一个词预测训练，而这本身就是一个 AI-complete 问题；靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让模型更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains a killer app, but thinking deepens: models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但思考在深化：模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出推理时算力扩展是近期最大机会；更长的上下文窗口与专家混合等模块化稀疏架构，能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展能推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习与在复杂环境中行动才是关键。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped: its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估：其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，而编程作为 AI 应用被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身进步。
